overview.text: Her campaign says that as Treasurer, she has overseen a state investment portfolio of $150 to $250 billion and helped secure top bond ratings for California. In the Assembly, she authored legislation to ban toxic chemicals in baby products and to strengthen protections for victims of domestic violence. On the Board of Equalization, she ordered three external audits of the agency.
